data.name: Fearless
data.description: Immune to morale checks and suppression effects.

data.name: Lone Wolf
data.description: Receives no penalty when operating without support units.

data.name: Energy Shield(1)
data.description: Absorbs the first 1 point of damage from each attack before armor saves apply.

data.name: Energy Shield(2)
data.description: Absorbs the first 2 points of damage from each attack before armor saves apply.

data.name: Swarm
data.description: Can ignore terrain penalties. Enemy blast weapons gain +1 Attack against this unit.

data.name: Berserk
data.description: When below half wounds, gains +1 Attack and +1 Strength but cannot fall back.

data.name: Rapid Fire
data.description: Can fire twice if the unit did not move this turn.

data.name: Accurate
data.description: Re-roll one failed hit die per activation.

data.name: Sidearm
data.description: Can be used in addition to another weapon in the same activation.

data.name: Heavy
data.description: Cannot move and shoot in the same activation unless mounted in a vehicle.

data.name: Blast
data.description: Hits all models within 2 inches of the target on a 4+.

data.name: Anti-Vehicle
data.description: +1 Damage against Vehicle type units.

data.name: Melee
data.description: This weapon can only be used in close combat.

data.name: Rending
data.description: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 causes one additional mortal wound.

data.name: Unwieldy
data.description: Unit strikes last in close combat unless it charged this turn.

data.name: Overcharge
data.description: Can be fired in overcharge mode: double Attacks but gains Unreliable for the activation.

data.name: EMP
data.description: On a successful hit, Vehicles lose their special abilities for one round.

data.name: Homing
data.description: Re-roll all failed hit rolls against Infantry targets.

data.name: Sticky
data.description: On a hit, the grenade attaches and cannot be avoided — defender takes full Blast hits.

data.name: One Use
data.description: This weapon may only be used once per battle.

data.name: Scout
data.description: Can deploy outside normal deployment zone.

data.name: Fast
data.description: May move an additional 3 inches per activation.

data.name: Flyer
data.description: Can only be hit on 6+ by non-AA weapons. Moves double speed.

data.name: Transport
data.description: Can carry X infantry models (specified in description).

data.name: Heavy Armor
data.description: Reduces AP of all incoming attacks by 1.

data.name: Artillery
data.description: Can shoot at targets not visible to the firer.

data.name: Huge
data.description: Blocks line of sight. Can be targeted by any weapon regardless of range.

data.name: AA
data.description: Can target flyers. Non-flyers can only target this unit with AA weapons.
